item.title: Cloud Registry
item.description:
Alexander Kanitz, Kushagra Nagori, Christina Herrmann, Anita Arora, Tristan Perard
Cloud Registry is a registry of web services for projects, networks and infrastructures that implements the GA4GH Service Registry API, so that clients can discover services and their API types, versions and operators in one place. Anyone can read the entries; users authenticated with a trusted OpenID Connect provider can register and manage services, and admins can verify them. It is built with FOCA and deployed with Docker Compose or its Helm chart.
